description: The logged-in user's Claude.ai usage settings page: current plan plus session and weekly usage limits with reset times.

needs_auth.hint: Ask the user to sign in to claude.ai in the open tab, then retry this call.

map.limits: [limits.{ 'name': kind = 'session' ? 'Current session' : kind = 'weekly_all' ? 'Weekly limit' : kind = 'weekly_scoped' ? ((scope.model.display_name ? scope.model.display_name & ' ' : '') & 'weekly limit') : kind, 'used': used_dollars ? $string(used_dollars) : '', 'limit': limit_dollars ? $string(limit_dollars) : '', 'percent': $string(percent) & '%', 'resets_at': resets_at }]

resolve.post: ($a := $substringAfter(dialog, 'Plan usage limits'); ($contains(dialog, 'Plan usage limits') and $contains($a, 'Current session')) ? { 'plan': $trim($substringBefore($a, 'Current session')) } : {})

resolve.prompt: This is the Claude.ai usage settings page. Return a single object {plan, limits}. plan is the current subscription plan name (e.g. 'Pro', 'Max 5x', 'Max (20x)', 'Team') shown under the 'Plan usage limits' heading. limits is an array of usage meters: for each return {name, used, limit, percent, resets_at} where name is the meter label (e.g. 'Current session', 'Weekly limit', 'Fable weekly limit'), used and limit are the raw values shown (else ''), percent is the fill percentage if displayed (else ''), and resets_at is the reset time/date text if shown (else ''). If the page is a login/sign-in page, return the JSON string "needs_auth".
